passages.title: Ilavazhagi's Background
passages.text_en: Ilavazhagi pursued her dreams despite facing various difficulties. Her father, a former carrom player whose own career was hindered by a lack of support, channeled his aspirations into his daughter by training her from a very early age.

passages.title: Ilavazhagi's Background
passages.text_en: Ilavazhagi is a carrom champion who represents India in international competitions. Her father, a fish-cart driver, coached her from a young age despite the family's financial struggles and cramped living conditions.

passages.title: Grandfather's Garden
passages.text_en: The narrator recalls watching a vine slowly reach toward their grandfather, who was a retired Indian Forest Service officer residing near Dehradun. The grandfather's garden thrived with various trees and plants, and he believed in maintaining a connection with nature to attract wildlife like butterflies, while his wife preferred cultivating flowers.

passages.title: Ajay Kumar Garg
passages.text_en: Ajay Kumar Garg is a skilled artist from Jaipur who became hearing impaired after a childhood injury. Despite this, he discovered a talent for painting, eventually studying under Suo Lal and Asha Devi to become an expert in traditional Indian miniature art, even painting on grains of rice.

passages.title: Constitutional Amendment Bill 2024
passages.text_en: The 129th Constitutional Amendment Bill proposes holding simultaneous elections for both the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies. It introduces Article 82(A) to align election schedules and term lengths, with specific changes taking effect after the 2029 general elections.

passages.title: TN Morning Breakfast Scheme
passages.text_en: The Tamil Nadu government launched a major morning breakfast scheme to improve human resource capital. Research indicates that regular breakfast intake correlates with better academic grades, higher happiness indices, and improved school attendance.

passages.title: Breakfast Scheme Context
passages.text_en: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister views education as invaluable wealth that cannot be stolen. The government's breakfast scheme aims to provide equal opportunities for all children. By prioritizing education and nutrition, the state seeks to enhance human resource capital and boost economic prosperity.

passages.title: Gender Justice and Public Transport
passages.text_en: For decades, Tamil Nadu has prioritized gender justice, leading to high female workforce participation. The COVID-19 pandemic worsened economic vulnerabilities for women, prompting the state to launch the Vidiyal Payanam Scheme in 2021, which provides free bus travel for female commuters.

passages.title: State Planning Commission Study
passages.text_en: To assess how a government scheme affected female travelers, the State Planning Commission conducted a two-stage evaluation. This study targeted Chennai and three other urban centers, specifically Nagapattinam, Madurai, and Tiruppur, to analyze demographic and economic data of women commuters.

passages.title: India's Q3 FY25 Economic Performance
passages.text_en: India's GDP grew by 6.2% in the December quarter of FY25, supported largely by the primary sector. Despite this, manufacturing and services sectors showed slower growth, and future targets remain challenging due to global trade uncertainties and potential US tariffs.
